name: Pixel Sweep Transition
description: A radial mosaic reveals image fragments with adjustable density and copy motion.

settings.label: Play on entry
settings.description: Replay the entrance on mount and settings changes. Disable for manually triggered navigation.

settings.label: Heading
settings.description: Demo headline. Line breaks are preserved; custom React children own their own copy.

settings.label: Caption
settings.default: Small details come together. A new scene takes shape.
settings.description: Demo supporting copy. Custom React children own their own copy.

settings.label: Canvas
settings.description: Receiving canvas behind the demo image. Visible while the image loads or wherever content leaves the canvas uncovered.

settings.label: Text
settings.description: Base demo copy and credit color. Below 600px the Mobile copy token overrides it; headline colors have separate desktop and compact tokens.

settings.label: Cover
settings.description: Outgoing navigation cover color, also used for the incoming opaque-grid fallback when custom content has no image. Image mosaics use Pixel backdrop instead.

settings.label: Minimum height
settings.description: Minimum receiving area height in pixels. The layout follows its container width.

settings.label: Tile fade
settings.description: Fade time in milliseconds for each individual tile. Radial delay, grid size, Entry delay and Covered hold determine the complete mosaic sequence.

settings.label: Navigation cover
settings.description: Outgoing cover duration in milliseconds. Applies to Next scene, cover() and navigate(), not Replay reveal.

settings.label: Radial delay
settings.description: Delay in milliseconds per unit of radial grid distance from Pixel origin. Farther tiles begin later; this is not a delay between every tile in index order.

settings.label: Covered hold
settings.description: Covered pause in milliseconds after Entry delay, before the mosaic and demo copy begin.

settings.label: Entry delay
settings.description: Initial reveal delay in milliseconds. Navigation cover uses its separate duration.

settings.label: Grid columns
settings.description: Mosaic columns. Total work is capped at 900 tiles; rows may be reduced to stay within the cap.

settings.label: Motion curve
settings.description: Fade curve for image tiles or the opaque-grid fallback. Demo copy, replay button and credit retain their own movement curves.

settings.label: Pixel origin
settings.description: Corner from which the radial image sweep begins.

settings.label: Grid rows
settings.description: Requested mosaic rows, limited by the 900-tile total budget.

settings.label: Copy entrance
settings.description: Shared duration in milliseconds for demo copy, replay button and credit movement.

settings.label: Copy horizontal travel
settings.description: Demo copy starts this many pixels to the left. Set to 0 to remove its horizontal travel.

settings.label: Replay vertical travel
settings.description: Demo replay button starts this many pixels above its resting position, after copy entry.

settings.label: Credit vertical travel
settings.description: Demo credit starts this many pixels below its resting position.

settings.label: Pixel heading
settings.description: Demo headline color at receiving widths of 1200px and above. Compact headline overrides it below 1200px.

settings.label: Pixel compact heading
settings.description: Demo headline color at receiving widths below 1200px. Desktop headline applies at larger widths.

settings.label: Pixel mobile copy
settings.description: Demo supporting copy and credit color at receiving widths of 600px or less. Larger widths inherit the Text color.

settings.label: Pixel unrevealed ground
settings.description: Canvas between fragments during an image mosaic. Applies to demo imagery or custom media with data-pt-image; it does not affect the opaque-grid fallback.
